newsitem.title: USA: ComEd reduces power at Ill. Dresden 2 nuke.
newsitem.headline: ComEd reduces power at Ill. Dresden 2 nuke.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) reduced output at the 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 2 nuclear power plant in Morris, Ill., to perform maintenance this past weekend, a company spokesman said.
"They expect to come back up shortly," said spokesman Gary Wald, but did not provide a specific date toward startup.
Dresden 2 was running at about 50 percent of capacity while work and testing were being performed on its main steam isolation valves, he said.
The neighboring Dresden 3, also rated at 794 MW, was operating a little below 80 percent of capacity ahead of its scheduled refueling outage in March 1997, Wald said.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary Unicom Corp.
